title: Implement check_convergence_rate()
objective: Implement check_convergence_rate(errors, mesh_sizes, expected_rate, tol) -> ConvergenceResult in verify/convergence.py. Fit log-log slope of error vs h and assert rate ≥ expected - tol.
implementation_steps: Define ConvergenceResult dataclass: measured_rate, expected_rate, passed, errors, mesh_sizes
Implement check_convergence_rate: compute log-log slope via np.polyfit(np.log(h), np.log(e), 1)
Compare slope against expected_rate with tolerance
acceptance_criteria: Correct rate extraction from known O(h^2) data
risks: Risk: log-log slope fitting may be imprecise with exactly 3 data points. Mitigation: require minimum 3 points, recommend 4+ for production use.
